subjectFilter.description:
Filter to select the subjects in scope for a single training group.
If null, all the subjects that are in scope of the project associated with training group is used.

groupBy.description:
Specifies how many models to train for this group, by splitting up the subjects using a "group by" operation.
For example, to train a model per {@link MlSubject}, then specify "id".
To train a model per group-of-subjects, by country, then specify "country".
If unspecified, then a single model will be trained for the population of subjects defined by {@link #subjectFilter}.
If null, a single global model is trained.

start.description: Start date which would be used to evaluate {@link MlModel#xFeatures} and {@link MlModel#yFeatures} features.

end.description: End date which would be used to evaluate {@link MlModel#xFeatures} and {@link MlModel#yFeatures} features.

title:
Specifies inputs for fetching training data and groups of subjects to train on.
Users can extend this type, and override the {@link MlModel.Train.Strategy#timeRange} for custom functionality.
name: MlModel.Train.Strategy
